types.description: TeSys D 4-pole contactor / AC-1 25 A / 4 NO power poles + 1 NO + 1 NC integrated instantaneous auxiliary / 24 V DC coil (code BD)

document.title: Schneider Electric LC1DT25BD product data sheet
document.pages: 1-3; applicable B8/12, B8/24 and B8/79 catalogue and 1378323_01A55 instruction are cited in modelingNotes

modelingNotes: Manufacturer exact reference LC1DT25BD matches source LC1-DT25BD; the source presentation hyphen is retained. Exact January 13, 2021 product sheet, pages 1-3, confirms four NO main poles, factory 1NO+1NC auxiliary, screw clamps, and BD standard 24 VDC coil. No successor is substituted.

Applicable manufacturer contact diagram: https://iportal2.schneider-electric.com/Contents/docs/B8_CONTACTORS_EN_CATALOGUE.PDF , physical B8/79, scheme 127267.eps LC1DT20 to DT80A, linked to the exact B8/12 LC1DT25 selection row. Four NO pairs are 1/L1-2/T1, 3/L2-4/T2, 5/L3-6/T3 and 7/L4-8/T4; factory auxiliary 13/NO-14 is NO and 21/NC-22 is NC. All six contacts are actuated by the coil.

Coil A1 is positive and A2 negative. Exact product page links manufacturer instruction https://download.se.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=1378323_01A55 (printed W9 1378323 0211 A14, 02/2021; inset retains A11), page 1: the terminal table explicitly includes LC1DT25 and the assembly drawing labels A1+ and A2-. Schneider FAQ FA121938 https://www.se.com/ca/en/faqs/FA121938/ independently confirms DC coil polarity. Bidirectional suppression does not establish arbitrary coil polarity.

The terminal keys A1, A2, 13 and 21 retain the schematic numbering. Manufacturer A1+, A2-, 13/NO and 21/NC are documented polarity/function-labelled aliases, not extra terminals. Polarity is stated in descriptions because the terminal schema has no dedicated polarity or alias field; it is not an automatic reversed-supply diagnostic.

The exact product sheet page 3 specifies 5.4 W inrush and holding at 20 C; operation 0.7-1.25 Uc at -40 to 60 C, 1-1.25 Uc at 60 to 70 C, and dropout 0.1-0.25 Uc at -40 to 70 C. B8/12 selection prints 0.75-1.25 Uc while B8/62 characteristics prints 0.7-1.25 Uc at 60 C; this published lower-limit difference is preserved, not silently reconciled. These are notes, not simulated thresholds.

Standard built-in bidirectional peak-limiting suppression is removable/replaceable. B8/24 includes LC1DT20-DT40 DC, lists LAD4TBDL for 24 VDC, and specifies LAD9DL blanking plug if used without suppression; clipping makes the electrical connection. Instruction page 1 depicts the DC suppressor and blanking arrangements. The installed unit has not been inspected.

Physical connection coverage is partial beyond the fourteen established field screw terminals. The removable suppressor has two unnumbered accessory mating ends that are not individually mapped or modeled here. They are not extra field screw terminals. Optional coil-wiring adapter, auxiliary/timer/latch add-ons and their terminals are excluded.

No fixed net links are asserted through moving contacts, coil or suppression. Mechanical actuation and mirror-contact qualification do not imply permanent continuity. No protective-earth, shield or communication terminal is identified in the applicable field-terminal diagram; none is invented, and mounting does not establish bonding.

Required A1/A2 is an explicit library policy for the modeled operating contactor. Main and auxiliary contact usage is application-dependent, so those terminals are optional. This is not a manufacturer claim that every stored or unused contactor must be energized. Shared connection policy does not encode or enforce the maximum of two conductors per clamp.

Conditional ratings remain in notes: 25 A AC-1 at <=440 VAC and the published ambient condition (<60 C on the exact sheet; <=60 C on B8/12); power Ith 25 A and signalling Ith 10 A at 60 C. Power capability is <=690 VAC at 25-400 Hz or <=300 VDC. Minimum signal 17 V/5 mA. Capability voltage and thermal current are not universal terminal scalar limits; coil nominal is genuinely 24 VDC.

Exact sheet page 3 and applicable instruction page 1 specify 1.7 N.m screw-clamp torque. For power and control: one or two solid/unferruled flexible conductors 1-4 mm2; one ferruled flexible 1-4 mm2, two ferruled flexible 1-2.5 mm2. Wire preparation/count conditions remain notes. Factory auxiliary 1NO+1NC is mechanically linked; its NC is a mirror contact under the cited IEC standards, without timing or safety-certification simulation.

connectionCoverage.notes: All fourteen field-wiring terminals and seven schematic functions are established: eight main, four factory auxiliary, and one A1+ / one A2-. The standard removable suppressor has two unnumbered accessory mating ends that are not individually mapped or modeled. This is partial coverage of all physical electrical interfaces; field screw inventory and coil polarity are established. No fixed continuity through coil, suppression or moving contacts is asserted. Optional add-ons and as-built suppressor state are outside scope.

13.description: Factory auxiliary NO terminal; manufacturer 13/NO is the documented alias of key 13.

21.description: Factory auxiliary NC terminal; manufacturer 21/NC is the documented alias of key 21; mirror-contact qualification is retained in notes.

A1.description: 24 VDC standard coil positive; manufacturer A1+ is the polarity-labelled alias of A1 (1378323_01A55 instruction, page 1).

A2.description: 24 VDC standard coil negative; manufacturer A2- is the polarity-labelled alias of A2 (1378323_01A55 instruction, page 1).
